title: Special Executive Masters Programme in Business Administration
description: Explore advanced business strategies and leadership techniques tailored for senior executives in the Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Business Administration.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Rushford Business School
longDescription: The Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Business Administration offers an intensive, practical curriculum to enhance leadership and strategic management skills for professionals aiming to advance their careers. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The Special Executive Master Programme in Business Administration allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The program effectively prepares learners to tackle complex operational challenges by integrating theoretical knowledge with practical applications.
courseDetails: The aim of the Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in Business Administration is to equip professionals with advanced knowledge and skills in leadership, strategic management, and business operations. The program focuses on practical applications to drive organizational success and personal career advancement. It also fosters critical thinking and innovative problem-solving abilities in a global business context. Course Details: Leadership and Organizational Behaviour: Explore theories and practices to cultivate effective leadership strategies and understand the dynamics of organizational behaviour. International Business Management: Gain insights into the complexities of global markets, cultural nuances, and international trade strategies for successful business expansion. Strategic Financial Management: Develop proficiency in financial analysis, risk management, and strategic decision-making to drive sustainable business growth and maximize shareholder value. Business Research Methods: Understand the research techniques and methodologies essential for evidence-based decision-making and business innovation. Strategic Human Resource Management: Learn to align human capital strategies with organizational goals, fostering employee engagement, talent development, and organizational effectiveness. Strategic Marketing: Learn to use market analysis, branding, and marketing strategies to create competitive advantage and drive business growth in dynamic market environments. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project(GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in business administration and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There are no Visa requirements for this Course as it is an Online Course.

modules.title: LEADERSHIP AND ORGANIZATIONAL BEHAVIOUR
modules.summary: The Leadership and Organizational Behavior module is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of leadership and the principles of organizational behaviour. This module will explore the various leadership styles, traits, and behaviours that are necessary for effective leadership in modern organizations.Students will learn how to analyze and evaluate organizational structures and culture and the impact of these factors on employee motivation, job satisfaction, and performance. They will also examine team building dynamics and the importance of communication, conflict resolution, and decision-making in achieving organizational objectives.

modules.title: INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: This course aims to introduce learners to current debates, theories, and practices in the field of International Business.

modules.title: STRATEGIC FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: On completion of this unit, learners will have gained knowledge and understanding relating to planning the usage and management of a business organization’s financial resources. Learners will understand the importance of attaining business objectives and maximizing shareholder return. Learners will gain a working knowledge of business strategy design and the production of comprehensive business plans.

modules.summary: To provide learners with the competence to proffer solutions to problems arising in relation to leadership, management, and development of human resources within the organizational contexts. Learners will be enabled to appraise the effectiveness of organizational strategies, processes, and practices in efficient and effective leadership and management, also the contribution of HRM/HRD practitioners to organizational change.

modules.summary: This unit aims to develop learners’ understanding of how the effective strategic management of human resources supports achieving organizational objectives in different contexts. Learners will evaluate the contribution of strategic human resource management and the application of leadership and management theory for organizational benefit.

modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of the concepts, methods and technical aspects of strategic marketing and the challenges associated with marketing in today’s business environment, including how a strategy combines product development, promotion, distribution, pricing, relationship management, and other elements.
